title: Building Blocks
blurb: From neural network foundations through transformers and attention to building your own GPT, understand what's actually happening inside large language models.

title: The Agentic Turn
blurb: From early demos to production systems, watch code agents become real tools. These conversations trace what's actually working in practice and what builders are learning at scale.

title: Reckoning with Superintelligence
blurb: A hard look at the stakes of advanced AI. From plausible takeoff scenarios to alignment challenges, these voices take seriously what could go wrong—and why it matters.

title: Creative Ecstasy
blurb: These are performances where you feel someone fully alive in the moment—music and energy building from quiet introspection into pure joy. The kind of videos that remind you why people make things in the first place.

title: The Remix
blurb: Thinkers and makers explaining how creativity actually works, from the words we use to the patterns in everything. Start with language, end with philosophy—all art is built from what came before.

title: Strange Beauty
blurb: Videos that find something worth holding onto in the weird, surreal, and unexpected. They don't fit into neat buckets, but they share a sense that beauty can emerge from dissonance if you sit with it long enough.

title: Weird First
blurb: The viral videos that defined an era before everyone was online. These are the moments—rickroll, Leeroy Jenkins, The Fox—when the internet got strange first and everything else just tried to keep up.

title: Everything's Broken
blurb: Engineers and comedians lovingly explain why the tech industry makes no sense. Microservices, web scale, why nobody should let an AI make decisions. Comedy from inside the disaster.

title: One Dancer
blurb: What happens when one person moves and everyone joins in. These videos are about momentum, group energy, and the beautiful chaos of a crowd that just can't help itself.

title: When Horses Leave
blurb: The horse didn't disappear because cars were better at being horses, but because they were better at doing what horses did. These videos explore what that pattern means for human labor in the age of AI—and whether this time is truly different.

title: From Game to Power
blurb: Markets look chaotic until you understand the incentives driving them. These videos trace game theory through real markets, the economics of coordination, and how power ultimately distorts systems meant to serve everyone.

title: Make Something New
blurb: Everything around you was made by people no smarter than you. These videos are about building new things: the philosophy, the craft, what's actually real, and lessons from people who did it.

title: The Precision Journey
blurb: From hand-scraped workshop surfaces to atoms arranged by machines worth $200 million, humans have spent centuries learning to make smaller and more precise. This is the story of that journey—and how people are bringing those techniques home.

title: Hidden Ingenuity
blurb: Your dishwasher is smarter than you're using it. Your pan has more engineering than you'd guess. The familiar objects in your home reveal themselves as carefully solved problems—if you look close enough.

title: Making at Home
blurb: Backyard engineers building artificial suns, marble machines, and 400-battery experiments. Projects that shouldn't work, materials pushed past their limits, and the peculiar joy of making something ambitious happen in your own space.

title: The Art of Undoing
blurb: Learn to work with your nervous system through breath and movement—and why the most powerful thing you can do is stop trying to force relaxation.

title: How You Carry Yourself
blurb: Discover what happens when you bring awareness into how you move, from the instant transformation of posture to the flow of mastered skill.

title: The Biology of Possibility
blurb: Biology is far more sophisticated than we usually realize. These videos explore the body's hidden systems and what becomes possible when science reveals them.

title: Small Minds, Big Wonders
blurb: Birds encode images into sound. Octopuses play instruments. Crows solve puzzles. A meditation on the intelligence and emotion woven through the living world, often in the most unexpected places.

title: Pale Blue Dot to the Far Future
blurb: From an astronaut's song in orbit to the heat death of the universe. This arc traces humanity's long journey from Earth outward, and imagines the vast scales of engineering and time ahead.

title: First Contact
blurb: Why hasn't humanity found aliens yet—or have we? A dive into the UFO phenomenon, the search for extraterrestrial life, and the unsettling possibility that we're not as alone as we think.

title: Sincerity Reawakening
blurb: Why meaning matters in a world that doesn't seem to care. This sequence works through the meaning crisis, the importance of earnestness over irony, identity puzzles, and practical moves toward building a meaningful life.

title: What Makes a Mind
blurb: How does consciousness actually work, and where does the mystery live? These conversations map the binding problem, field theories of experience, and what it might mean for AI and minds—sitting with the hard questions rather than rushing past them.

title: Awakening: The Inside View
blurb: Practitioners describe what happens when you actually train your attention on the mind itself. From meditation instruction through enlightenment experiences to what practitioners have learned about freedom, this is awakening lived firsthand.

title: The Pattern of Power
blurb: Power sustains itself not through obvious force but through hidden systems—psychology, media, algorithms, and social pressure. This sequence reveals how control operates in plain sight.

title: Citizens in Motion
blurb: Individual rights, alternative ways of living, and how to navigate institutions—a playlist for people trying to understand their agency in systems designed to constrain it.

title: Then and Now
blurb: From the broad sweep of history through the tensions of the present to the uncertainties of the future, a sequence that builds perspective on where we've been and where we might be headed.

title: The Seeing Eye
blurb: How your mind actually works—from the blind spots of attention to the prediction engine running underneath. A journey into perception, cognition, and how reality gets constructed.

title: The Weight We Carry
blurb: A compassionate exploration of difficult emotions—envy, shame, cringe, obsessive love—and the path toward healing. From understanding what you feel to befriending yourself.

title: Being Real With Others
blurb: How to connect across the gap between people—through listening, presence, and authenticity. From understanding how communication shapes us to the concrete skill of genuine friendship.

title: Scale and Wonder
blurb: A visual journey through layers of reality, from cosmic to cellular. Find wonder in how we measure the immeasurable and recognize patterns at every scale.

title: The Beauty of Constraints
blurb: Elegant mathematical puzzles that reveal why certain things can't exist. Watch simple rules spiral into complexity and encounter problems that refuse to yield.

title: Distributed Minds
blurb: What if intelligence isn't confined to brains? Explore how cells think, organisms compute, and minds might exist at scales we've never considered.

title: Tools for Thinking
blurb: From Engelbart's pioneering 1968 demo to modern talks on feedback and design, these videos explore how good tools and principles help creators think more clearly.

title: Playing at the Edges
blurb: Wonderfully weird explorations at the limits of computation: neural nets from floating-point errors, Turing-complete PowerPoint, Game of Life simulating itself, and Minecraft becoming a computer.

title: Where We Are
blurb: Reflections on where software went: Python's rise, the design choices that shaped us, and honest thinking from the people who've been building it all along.
